title: ep.match_subscription
description: Subscription an event is attached to (EP-H1..H6, EP-H8, EP-D3, EP-D4, EP-I5). The event of organization `organization_id` with `external_subscription_id` and `timestamp_json` is resolved against the listed subscriptions in `mode` (db = catalog read from the database per event, cache = memory-cache mode). Candidates: same organization, external id equal to `external_subscription_id`, `started_at <= t` and (`terminated_at` absent or `terminated_at >= t`) where t is the matching instant (ep.parse_timestamp); order: open first, then `terminated_at` descending, then `started_at` descending; the first wins. If none and `recurring` is true, the lookup is repeated at `now` (EP-H3). Reference quirks graded by compat vectors: binary64 matching instant (EP-D3), DB mode compares the wall clock of an RFC 3339 offset (EP-D4), bounds truncated to milliseconds in DB mode but compared at microseconds in cache mode (EP-H5), cache mode also matches an external id that starts with the looked-up id followed by `:` (EP-H8). Corrected: RBD-15, RBD-16, RBD-17, RBD-99 (exact external-id equality in both modes). Subscription `status` is not read (EP-H2). Every listed subscription is visible: the cache-mode snapshot window (EP-H7) is out of scope of the op. An invalid timestamp is the domain error `build_enriched_event` (EP-D1).

x-kit-errors.when: the timestamp is invalid (EP-D1); raised before any lookup

mode.description: Catalog mode of the reference whose behaviour is graded (compat); the corrected profile answers the same in both.

external_subscription_id.description: The event's external_subscription_id (byte-equal comparison, no trimming).

timestamp_json.description: Exact JSON text of the event's `timestamp` (as ep.parse_timestamp).

started_at.description: Start of the subscription (stored with microsecond precision).

status.description: Stored status code (0 pending, 1 active, 2 terminated, 3 canceled, 4 incomplete); not read by the reference (EP-H2).

subscriptions.description: Catalog subscription rows visible to the lookup.

recurring.description: The billable metric is recurring (enables the fallback lookup at `now`, EP-H3).

now.x-kit-absent: the processing time (wall clock), as the reference; vectors that reach the recurring fallback always pass it (TIME-2)
now.description: Processing time used by the recurring fallback; read only when `recurring` is true.

subscription_id.description: Id of the matched subscription; "" = none (EP-H4).

plan_id.description: Optional: plan of the matched subscription, "" = none (not graded by the v1 vectors).
